key_insight: quorum growth command provides Chronicle learning health monitoring with growth rate, days-since-last-commit, and actionable advice when stalled.
decision: quorum growth is a standalone CLI command (not a sentinel subcommand) that measures Chronicle growth rate, flags SLOW (7d) / STALLED (14d) status, shows a weekly sparkline, and surfaces pending proposals with commit instructions.
rejected_reason: top-level command is more discoverable and matches the concept weight
